description.en: The ID of the outbound task.

descriptions.zh:
启动预测外呼任务

1个企业最多有10个在运行或暂停状态的任务；

1个座席只能在1个运行或暂停的任务中;

任务中默认至少10个可用座席（不包含置忙的座席），否则任务启动后会自动暂停；

任务运行过程中，座席平均接听时延需要小于2秒，否则任务将会自动结束；

任务运行过程中，接通率过低，任务会自动结束；
descriptions.en:
Starts a predictive outbound task.

An enterprise can have a maximum of 10 running or paused tasks at a time.

An agent can be in only one running or paused task at a time.

By default, a task requires at least 10 available agents, excluding agents in a busy state. Otherwise, the task automatically pauses after it starts.

If the average agent answer delay exceeds 2 seconds while the task is running, the system automatically terminates the task.

If the call connection rate is too low while the task is running, the system automatically terminates the task.
